answer_1.quote: In this work, we experiment on several datasets and a downstream task, as well as performing extensive analysis of our method, reaching several conclusions: • By combining a small domain expert and a large black-box model, the combined model outperforms either of the original ones in all cases, by as much as 9% perplexity for domain adaptation, and 6% BLEURT for MT, showing the effectiveness of our approach.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in machine translation and domain-adapted language modeling, where the combined model generates text continuations or translations by leveraging a black-box LM and a fine-tuned small LM.

answer_2.quote: Following the recommended practice in the area , we use BLEURT  on the WMT21 test set as our evaluation metric, and report additional results with BLEU  in Appendix B.
